|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren]] (version 2 of 3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 22]] (2 October 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 6 October 2023: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While in battle alone: your total power here is +3, battle destiny draws may not be added and, if defending, once per game may take an Interrupt (except Ghhhk) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if alone).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren]] (repository revision 2 October 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren”; the printed face matches the image in visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).

Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if alone).” '''What changed:''' The words are unchanged. The round faction icon at top left was redrawn (the first image shows a solid ring, the re-made image thin red spokes). No errata mark.
